name: Omi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Omi village emblem in white: a thin ring enclosing a stylised character of pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Omi, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Omi village emblem — a thin ring enclosing a stylised character of pointed strokes
